text:
sam: Proposal: migrate console telemetry to an envelope versioning approach instead of a full separate table. Aim is to minimize backfill IO while giving us a v2 shape to iterate on. Requesting quick reviews on rollout windows and dashboard fallbacks.

maya: Sounds promising. can you outline the concrete steps and estimated windows? we need to sync with console release. :calendar:

sam: Steps: (1) add envelope_version int and packed attrs to existing route_metrics table (nullable) (2) dual-write envelope v1+v2 for 36h (3) targeted backfill for console-critical aggregates (p50/p95/token_cost) for last 7 days, prioritized by org usage (4) enable per-org read flag for v2, start with 5% canary, compare panels in console (5) ramp to 100% after parity checks.

jonathan: Two concerns: (A) idempotency when dual-writing+backfilling, (B) dashboard query plans if we change column types. idempotency keys and normalized aggregates will help.

alex: I prefer envelope in-place. Avoids table bloat and keeps joins stable for existing queries. For idempotency, add a dedupe key: `ingest_dedup_key = tenant||'|'||hour||'|'||route_id||'|'||envelope_version`. Ingest service should upsert on that key.

lina: Dashboard UX must be stable. plan must include a side-by-side diff card and a per-org toggle `telemetry.v2_reads`. we should also define an automated gating rule: average delta < 2% for 24h on canary orgs.

sam: Agreed. Draft SQL changes (trimmed):

```sql
ALTER TABLE route_metrics
  ADD COLUMN envelope_version int DEFAULT 1,
  ADD COLUMN v2_attrs jsonb,
  ADD COLUMN v2_p50_ms int,
  ADD COLUMN v2_p95_ms int,
  ADD COLUMN v2_token_cost numeric;

CREATE INDEX ON route_metrics (tenant_id, hour_ts) WHERE envelope_version = 2;
```

jonathan: That looks reasonable. Avoid relying on jsonb for filters we need in dashboards. Precompute the common fields (v2_p50_ms etc) as you added. Also, index choice should favor our frequent WHERE clauses.

alex: Backfill strategy: run targeted aggregates only for console-critical metrics. That reduces backfill IO massively. Backfill job should include a unique job id and write with dedup key so if it retries we don't double-count. BF job id like BF-1718.

ingest-bot: NOTICE: Backfill worker will throttle if write_latency_p90 > 200ms for 5m. Backfill BF-1718 scheduled for 2026-04-14T01:00:00Z, window 3h. Monitor link: https://internal/ops/jobs/BF-1718

maya: Console team: can we get a small API on the feature flag service to toggle per-org reads? we want to enable the diff view automatically for canary set.

lina: Also need a verification suite: SQL checks and thresholds. Who owns it? I'll want it in ops repo with runbook.

jonathan: I'll own verification. Example check: for org X, compare SUM(v2_token_cost) vs SUM(token_cost) grouped by hour for last 7 days. compute relative error; if >2% for >3 hours pause rollout. I'll add tooling that emits metric `telemetry.migration.delta_pct`.

sam: Retention policy: v2 fields hot for 90 days, then compact to hourly/week aggregates for 1 year. We'll document mapping so console compaction reads still work.

alex: Small but important: add write tag `migration=telemetry_envelope_v2` on all writes and emit a counter `ingest.v2_writes` so we can monitor adoption and debug regressions without touching main queries.

maya: UX: the diff card should show absolute numbers, relative delta, and a sparkline. Also show a small "why might these differ" note when delta>1% (backfill lag, sampling).

sam: Decision update: go envelope approach + targeted backfill of console-critical aggregates only. Full attr backfill deferred to later. I'll draft runbook and include rollback steps (clear v2 flag, disable reads, backfill cancel).

lina: Please add a customer communication note for public API consumers if any schema semantics change. We should be explicit about no breaking changes for published ingestion contract.

jonathan: Implementation nit: make dedupe key deterministic and stash it in a compact column (ingest_dedup_key text) to speed up upserts and avoid hashing overhead.

ingest-bot: INFO: Backfill BF-1718 queued. Resource group: backfill-large. Alerting: if cpu_util > 65% for 10m, job will pause and notify @eng-platform.

sam: Thanks all. I'll post the runbook PR and schedule a brief switchover window with console release. :rocket:

alex: tiny follow-up: include a small migration metric `console.migration.enabled_org_count` so PMs can track adoption, please.

maya: and please add the diff panel mock to the PR so console can implement before we enable canary.

sam: Will do. End.
